children: Your health data, only with your say-so
Review what we read and why, then choose. You can decline and keep using Kokonada in mood-only mode.

Kokonada turns how your body is doing into music tuned to you. To do that we need your explicit permission to read health and biometric data from your wearable. This is special-category data under GDPR Article 9, so we ask you here — clearly and up front — before anything is read.

• Heart rate
• Heart-rate variability (HRV)
• Sleep sessions
• Resting heart rate
• Historical readings (up to ~6 months back)
• Blood oxygen (SpO₂) — from a connected Garmin device
• Respiration rate — from a connected Garmin device
• Body Battery — from a connected Garmin device
• Training Readiness — from a connected Garmin device
These readings personalise your session in the moment and are summarised into a private profile that shapes future recommendations. They are never sold, and never used for advertising.
We keep only what personalisation needs and no longer. Raw samples are minimised over time; withdrawing your consent erases the health data held across your connected wearables.
Music intelligence is generated with Groq (our AI provider), and your readings originate from your wearable/health provider. These sub-processors act only on our instructions to deliver the service.
Consent is optional — the app works in mood-only mode without it. You can withdraw at any time from your Profile, which stops biometric personalisation and erases the health data held for you.
